mapper.insert: INSERT INTO executing_event (title, event_serial_number, operator_id, reg_date, from_dt, to_dt, place_name, place_addr) VALUES(#{title}, #{eventSerialNumber}, #{operatorId}, #{regDate}, #{fromDt}, #{toDt}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddr});
mapper.select: SELECT ee.id, ee.title, ee.event_serial_number, ee.operator_id, ee.reg_date, ee.from_dt, ee.to_dt, ee.place_name, ee.place_addr, e.event_type, e.description, e.create_dt, e.update_dt, e.create_user_id, e.update_user_id, e.status_of_event FROM executing_event ee INNER JOIN event e ON ee.id = e.id WHERE ee.id = #{id};
